name: The Companions
description: The companions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)

questions.question: What do we call the companions of Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: The Sahaba are the blessed companions who knew and believed in the Prophet.

questions.question: Who was the Prophet's closest friend and the first Caliph?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq was the Prophet's best friend and became the first Caliph.

questions.question: Who was the first muezzin of Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal, known for his beautiful voice, was chosen to call the Adhan.

questions.question: Which companion was the Prophet's cousin and married his daughter Fatimah?
questions.explanation: Ali ibn Abi Talib was the Prophet's cousin and married Fatimah.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Khadijah, the Prophet's wife, was the first believer in Islam.

questions.question: What do we say after mentioning a companion's name?
options: May Allah be pleased with him/her
questions.explanation: We say 'radiyallahu anhu/anha' — may Allah be pleased with him or her.

questions.question: Who was the young companion who served the Prophet for ten years?
questions.explanation: Anas ibn Malik served the Prophet from a young age, and the Prophet never scolded him.

questions.question: The Muslims who migrated from Mecca to Medina are called what?
questions.explanation: The Muhajirun are the migrants who left their homes in Mecca for Allah's sake.

questions.question: The Muslims of Medina who welcomed and helped the migrants are called what?
questions.explanation: The Ansar ('helpers') of Medina shared their homes and wealth with the migrants.

questions.question: Which companion was known for narrating the most hadiths?
questions.explanation: Abu Hurairah loved learning and narrated more hadiths than any other companion.

questions.question: Who was the brave uncle of the Prophet called the 'Lion of Allah'?
questions.explanation: Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib was known for his courage and strength.

questions.question: Which wife of the Prophet was the daughter of Abu Bakr?
questions.explanation: Aisha, daughter of Abu Bakr, was a great scholar who taught many Muslims.

questions.question: What was Abu Bakr's famous title?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq because he always believed the Prophet immediately.

questions.question: What was Umar ibn al-Khattab's famous title?
questions.explanation: Umar was called Al-Faruq because he clearly separated right from wrong.

questions.question: Which companion was called 'Dhun-Nurayn' (possessor of two lights)?
questions.explanation: Uthman married two of the Prophet's daughters (one after the other), earning this title.

questions.question: Which companion was known as the 'Sword of Allah'?
questions.explanation: Khalid ibn al-Walid was a brilliant military leader called Sayfullah, the Sword of Allah.

questions.question: Who suggested digging a trench to defend Medina?
questions.explanation: Salman al-Farisi, from Persia, suggested the trench — a new idea in Arabia.

questions.question: Which companion was sent to Medina as its first teacher of Quran?
questions.explanation: Young Mus'ab ibn Umayr taught the people of Medina about Islam before the Hijrah.

questions.question: Who was the first martyr (shaheed) in Islam?
questions.explanation: Sumayyah, the mother of Ammar, was the first person to give her life for Islam.

questions.question: Which companion freed Bilal from slavery?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr bought Bilal's freedom when he was being tortured for his faith.

questions.question: Which companion collected the Quran into one book during Abu Bakr's caliphate?
questions.explanation: Zayd ibn Thabit, a scribe of revelation, led the careful collection of the Quran.

questions.question: Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) was famous for what?
questions.explanation: Aisha was one of the greatest scholars among the companions and taught for decades.

questions.question: What are the wives of the Prophet called?
questions.explanation: The Quran calls the Prophet's wives 'Ummahat al-Mu'minin' — Mothers of the Believers.

questions.question: Which young companion did the Prophet make an army leader as a teenager?
questions.explanation: Usama ibn Zayd was chosen to lead an army while still very young, showing trust in youth.

questions.question: How many companions were promised Paradise in one famous hadith?
questions.explanation: Ten companions were given the good news of Paradise, known as al-Ashara al-Mubashshara.

questions.question: Which companion's dua for rain was answered when Umar asked him to pray during a drought?
questions.explanation: Umar asked Abbas, the Prophet's uncle, to make dua for rain, honoring the Prophet's family.

questions.question: Which companion is called the scholar of this Ummah for his tafsir knowledge?
questions.explanation: The Prophet prayed for Ibn Abbas to understand the Quran, and he became a master of tafsir.

questions.question: Which companion from Abyssinia (Ethiopia) is honored in Islamic history?
questions.explanation: Bilal came from Abyssinia; Salman from Persia and Suhayb from Rome — Islam united all peoples.

questions.question: Who did the Prophet say would be the leader of the women of Paradise?
questions.explanation: The Prophet gave his daughter Fatimah this glad news.

questions.question: Which two companions are buried next to the Prophet in Medina?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr and Umar are buried beside the Prophet in Masjid an-Nabawi.

questions.question: Which companion led the Muslims in prayer when the Prophet was very ill?
questions.explanation: The Prophet asked Abu Bakr to lead the prayers during his final illness.

questions.question: Under which Caliph was the Quran copied and sent to different Muslim lands?
questions.explanation: Uthman had official copies of the Quran made and sent to the major cities.

questions.question: Which companion was famous for his knowledge of halal and haram?
questions.explanation: The Prophet praised Mu'adh ibn Jabal's knowledge and sent him to teach in Yemen.

questions.question: What did Abu Bakr do with his wealth for Islam?
options: He spent nearly all of it for Allah's cause
He gave it only to family
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr spent his wealth freeing enslaved Muslims and supporting the community.

questions.question: Which companion stayed loyal at Uhud, shielding the Prophet with his own body?
questions.explanation: Talha protected the Prophet at Uhud and was badly wounded doing so.

questions.question: What lesson do we learn from the friendship of the Sahaba?
options: Brotherhood and helping each other for Allah's sake
questions.explanation: The companions showed us true brotherhood, sacrifice, and love for Allah's sake.
